title: Technology Park ABM: agent-based model of technology parks and innovation ecosystems
description:
Reproducible agent-based model of a technology park that studies when interactions among startups, anchor firms, universities, investors, workers, and park governance generate increasing returns.

The model is deterministic under a supplied seed, performs no network calls, and ships with the investigation workbench (seeded execution, synthesis verdicts), experiment runners (E1-E7), Morris/Sobol global sensitivity analysis, pattern-oriented validation, and a validated public-data pipeline. Simulation outputs are labeled as simulation and are never presented as empirical facts.
